fields.description:
A successful no-wait pull request promotion returns after `PR_CREATED`. The workflow has completed, but the execution row remains non-terminal. The row holds a platform concurrency slot until orphan reconciliation marks the successful run `CANCELLED`.

Investigation reproduced the no-wait path with a successful workflow result of `pr_promoted` and persisted states ending in `PR_CREATED`. The await-close path persists `AWAITING_PR_CLOSE`, waits for `submit_pr_closed`, then persists `COMPLETED` after merge. `PostgresWorkflowResolver.resolve` selects non-terminal rows so GitHub close webhooks signal workflows that are parked on pull request close. A no-wait workflow has already returned, so excluding a `COMPLETED` row is expected.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The no-wait promotion path persists `COMPLETED` before returning, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_draft_pull_request_workflow.py -k no_wait_promotion_persists_completed_terminal_state`
- [x] The await-close promotion path still persists `AWAITING_PR_CLOSE`, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_draft_pr_close_workflow.py -k await_pr_close_path_persists_awaiting_pr_close`
- [x] The pull request close resolver ignores terminal rows, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_pr_events.py -k resolver_ignores_terminal_execution_rows`
- [x] The pull request close resolver prioritizes the waiting workflow, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_pr_events.py -k resolver_prioritizes_awaiting_pr_close_workflow`
- [x] The active run counter excludes completed executions, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_execution_persistence.py -k active_count_excludes_completed_executions`

## Testing
Create `tests/unit/test_pr_events.py` for pull request close resolver unit coverage. Run each acceptance selector on its own. Run `PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/inv ci` before closing.
